Output verified with ffprobe directly on the returned MP4: 124 frames @ 24 fps = 5.166667s, exactly matching the requested 5s/124-frame shape (the API's own JSON `seconds` field reported a stale '4' on both the submit and completed response -- a cosmetic metadata default unrelated to the real generation params, not a real duration shortfall; confirmed by decoding the actual file). Still uses the recipe's memory-constrained --dlo-resident-layers 20 offload even though B200's 183 GB has no need for it -- vllm-omni ships only one documented 2-GPU H3 recipe, so this is that recipe as-is, not a B200-tuned command; a fully-resident vllm-omni command may be faster but is not a documented starting point. Same request, same 2xB200 hardware, sglang's b200-2gpu profile: 80.64s/80.63s client wall, 75.42s inference_time_s -- sglang is ~1.31x faster than vLLM-Omni here.

consumer-dlo-compile-20260807.notes: Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for MP4 muxing. The request also needs `aspect_ratio` inside extra_params (the recipe's own T2VA example omits it and 422s with 'RuntimeError: t2va requires an explicit aspect_ratio' as written). CONFIRMED HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT 2026-08-07: re-ran this exact profile on 2xB200 (sm100, datacenter Blackwell) -- it segfaults with the identical signature as on RTX 5090 (native segfault, Python trace through torch Dynamo's custom_eval_frame), 1 step into denoising. Same bug on two unrelated GPU architectures rules out a consumer-GPU/SM120 quirk; this is a real vLLM-Omni MiniMax-H3 stability bug in the compiled path, not something fixable from the benchmark harness. Use the enforce-eager / b200-2gpu profile instead.

vllm-omni.reason: Empirically validated 2026-08-07, first on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 (2x RTX 5090) then on 2xB200: the default (compiled) profile segfaults identically on both GPU classes 1 step into denoising (see command_profiles.default.notes) -- a confirmed hardware-independent vLLM-Omni bug, despite the recipe's own claim that torch.compile is 'not enabled by default on consumer paths.' --enforce-eager avoids that segfault, but on RTX 5090 it fails differently at startup (a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake, surfaced as EOFError) and never completes a request on that GPU class. On 2xB200 the identical --enforce-eager command works cleanly and completes a correct generation -- see command_profiles.b200-2gpu for the validated numbers and the sglang comparison on the same hardware. Net: vLLM-Omni H3 support is real but fragile below the B200 class tested here; RTX 5090 has no working profile for this case in either variant.

default.notes: VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-08): derived offline from LightX2V main 0c2edc12, never run. The two-GPU preset configs/minimax_h3/minimax_h3_tp.json, served as scripts/minimax_h3/server/start_server_ref2av.sh does: --model-variant ref2av loads transformer_ref/ (the partition sglang's --model-variant ref2va loads; LightX2V's base variant also accepts ref2av requests, which would be a different transformer), no startup --task, each request names task ref2av. The reference reaches it as image_path, the server-local path of the harness's prepared file (2048 px short edge, nearest 32, this request's marked variant); LightX2V's default reference_image_resize_mode 'diffusers' is that same rule, so it encodes the file unchanged (the 4-step reference LoRA preset's 'match' mode is not used). Kept from the preset: TP2 DiT, world-TP text encoder, resident DiT and text encoder, tile-parallel VAE decode, sgl-kernel RMSNorm, no feature caching. Deviations from the preset, all for the benchmark's lossless policy: attn_type flash_attn3 in place of sage_attn2 (int8-QK SageAttention, a different numeric class; FA3 is the fastest exact kernel on Hopper); use_compile true (harness default) with rope_type torch_real_rope, the pairing of upstream's compile preset configs/minimax_h3/minimax_h3_compile.json (an eager run should go back to minimax_h3_triton_rope), but warmup false: that preset's startup warmup compiles at 480x480x158 and 544x960x124, and under torch.compile(dynamic=None) the second shape recompiles every block shape-dynamic, so the case's shape would be served by that dynamic graph -- the harness warms at the measured shape instead; use_adaln_cache false (the preset's true is required only with cpu_offload): that cache serves the ~13B-parameter, timestep-only AdaLN projections from an offline artifact built for one schedule, while sglang runs the standard path in this benchmark (its --minimax-h3-adaln-cache-path is off too), and the projections it skips are a bandwidth-bound read of about 24 GiB of weights per step, split across TP ranks (est. 0.1-0.4% of a step); infer_steps 49 (preset: 29): LightX2V counts DiT evaluations on linspace(1, 0, infer_steps + 1), sglang's num_inference_steps 50 counts the points of linspace(1, 0, 50), so both run the same 49 forwards on the same grid, shifted 12 (video) / 3 (audio). size and num_frames come from each request ([768, 1344], 124). Weights: the repo's Diffusers-layout components (sglang reads the native FL2VA/ and Ref2VA/ partitions of the same repo and revision -- the same checkpoint, packaged twice by MiniMax); model_allow_patterns fetches only what LightX2V reads. vae_cpu_offload false (preset: true) on 141+ GB cards. vae_encode_parallel (tile-parallel encode of the reference) is left off as in every datacenter preset; it appears only in a 5090 FP8 config. First GPU round: the A/Bs listed for minimax_h3_t2va_5s. Needs LightX2V >= 9ea22feb (2026-09-10, --model-variant); the installer's default pin 7efd05f8 predates H3, so a round sets LIGHTX2V_INSTALL_SPEC to main.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official video_minimax_h3_r2v template with one reference image (the shared test image) and the full bf16 ref2va DiT. The reference is resized by the harness to the reference pipeline's shape -- 2048px short edge, upscaling allowed, LANCZOS, each side to the nearest 32 (sglang's reference_encoding.py, which vLLM-Omni's +51% over its T2VA also matches) -- and the node runs in 'max' mode, whose scale is exactly 1 at a 2048 short edge. ComfyUI's node never upscales, so without this the 1024x704 test image entered at 2816 reference tokens against about 23800 for the other rows: the 2026-09-25 round's first ComfyUI ref2va number (343.5s, only +8% over its T2VA while sglang/vLLM-Omni paid +53%/+51%) measured less work and is superseded. No CFG, as in sglang. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.

default.notes: Derived 2026-10-08 from FastVideo's Ref2VA recipe (SP = num_gpus, FSDP DiT, text encoder and VAE offloaded, eager DiT) for a resident server: no offload, `inference_torch_compile` (FastVideo's regional per-block compile, safe on FA2/FA3/FA4), VAE uncompiled so #1930's bitwise tile split runs. #1930/#1807's bit-identical switches are on (exact RoPE/AdaLN/SwiGLU kernels, VAE tile split, fused Ulysses all-to-all) and the output-changing ones off (FP32 round-once H3 fusions, FA4 packed varlen). The DiT stays FSDP-sharded on Hopper: replicated, the 66.3 GB DiT, the resident 66.7 GB Qwen3-VL and the 11 GB of VAEs come to 144 GB, more than a 141 GB H200 holds. FA3 is what FastVideo's FLASH_ATTN loads when FASTVIDEO_FA4=0 and flash_attn_interface imports; without it FastVideo falls back to SDPA silently. Steps: FastVideo counts sigma grid points as sglang does (scheduling_minimax_h3.py: linspace(1, 0, num_inference_steps)), so 50 runs 49 forwards, as on sglang; vLLM-Omni counts evaluations and runs 50 for the same field. The 12/3 shifts come from the checkpoint's scheduler configs: FastVideo rejects a flow_shift for H3. The reference arrives as the request's own image_reference data URI, already at the 2048px short edge (multiple of 32) that FastVideo's reference.py resolves, so FastVideo does not resize it again; the keyframe encode is split across the SP ranks (vae_parallel_encode plus the tile split), bitwise as #1930 states. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-08): check the log for 'Using FlashAttention-3 backend', that compile happens inside the harness warmups, and A/B against DIFFUSION_BENCH_DISABLE_TORCH_COMPILE=1 (eager, where the exact kernels take over).

_note: Ref2VA is selected by the conditions[] entry with role=reference, not by the harness's reference_image multipart path; __TEST_IMAGE_URL__ is substituted at request time with that request's own copy of meta.test_image_url as a data: URI (until 2026-09-30 with the URL itself, which the server downloaded inside the measured window). Validated on 2x H200 2026-08-26: 222.4s single_e2e (t2va on the same box is 146.7s -- reference conditioning costs ~1.5x). The harness hands every framework the reference already at the official rule's size (reference_short_edge/reference_multiple: 2048px short edge, upscaling allowed, LANCZOS, nearest 32 -- diffusers' MiniMax-H3 modular pipeline `reference_image_short_edge`, and sglang's reference_encoding.py). vLLM-Omni stopped upscaling small references on 2026-09-28 (#8253) and ComfyUI never does, so without this they condition on ~8x fewer reference tokens than the official pipeline (the 1024x704 test image: ~2800 vs ~23800). vLLM-Omni requests carry extra_params.preencode_mp4=true (2026-10-08): its documented, off-by-default overlap of MP4 encoding with the VAE decode (byte-identical frames), the counterpart of sglang's default streamed encode (#41819). Both engines run their best documented output path. vLLM-Omni gets num_inference_steps 49 (2026-10-08): since vllm-omni #7219 (2026-09-24) it reads N as N model passes on linspace(1, 0, N+1), while sglang, FastVideo and LightX2V's 49 read 50 as 50 sigma grid points, i.e. 49 passes; 49 gives Omni the identical 50-point grid. Earlier H3 rounds ran Omni one pass more.
